author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Faster loading: book covers and mascot resized (19.9 MB -> 0.5 MB, still sharp on high-resolution phones); the offline cache no longer pre-downloads ~23 MB of data on the first visit; code, styles and covers load instantly from the phone cache on return visits; data files are only re-downloaded when they change; the question bank preloads after the home screen instead of competing with it.
